prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1042; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at a signalized intersection involving your insured. Our client sustained serious injuries in the incident and has retained us to protect her legal rights and interests.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office. Do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person. Any inquiries from your company's representatives or adjusters should be routed to us.

We request that you provide a complete copy of the liability policy issued to your insured, including the declarations page, and disclose the bodily injury and property damage limits applicable to this loss.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes claim files, recorded statements, photographs, vehicle data, telematics and event data recorder information, repair estimates, salvage records, and any surveillance or dashcam footage. Destruction or alteration of such materials may result in sanctions.
